name: plane_soft_rubber_symmetric_contact_5n
parameter_origin: Illustrative synthetic values; not measured properties of a named commercial material.
material_label: Soft rubber-like solid, 5 N, symmetric contact pair
model_notes: Load-controlled at 5 N; travel is an outcome.
Velocity-weakening friction, as the shared suite specifies.

Contact penalty raised and the penetration threshold set above what it produces. Contact chattering across the faceted target, not the friction law, is what stopped every earlier slide; loosening the threshold alone cured the chattering but let penetration reach 26 um, which would corrupt the surface the tactile image is rendered from.
Contact defined both ways so ANSYS selects the pairing. The mesh ratio is only 1.4 and the stiffness ratio 2, so this is a mild violation of the guidance rather than a gross one.
